evidenceExport.readme.seal: A seal shows that the sealed item existed in exactly this form by the time of its qualified timestamp, and by the time of its Bitcoin anchor. It says nothing about whether the facts, the rules shown or the conclusion are correct or complete, and it is not a legal opinion.
